items.message:
Extract type parameters as `Type _` in Lean (#1412)

* Extract type parameters as `Type _` in Lean

`A → Result B` need not live in `Type`, so generic extracted code and the
Std models must accept types in any universe.

Extraction:
- Generic parameters and associated types are printed as `Type _`.
- Generic trait-method parameters (bound inside a structure field) and the
  result sort of opaque types stay in `Type`: Lean can't infer the level th

Add generic WPs for ITrees (#1344)

* Add generic coinductive specifications and refactor WP around them

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Add handler-based total and partial WPMonad interpretations

Prove generic bind and conjunction laws for coinductive specifications. Add opt-in WPMonad constructors and triple bridges for conjunctive stateful handlers while preserving the existing Result interpretation. C

Improve `intro_massert_visitor` following regressions in https://github.com/AeneasVerif/aeneas/pull/1379 (#1388)

* Use a fresh id when copying a symbolic value with no borrows

* Make intro_massert_visitor more general and regenerate the tests

Fix problems around `Aeneas.Std.bind` (#1340)

* Support heterogeneous binds in step tactics

Recognize Bind.bind and Aeneas.Std.bind when stepping and extracting continuation names, preserving bind tracing and arity diagnostics.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Consolidate WP rules under unprimed names

Retain the wrapped spec/dspec mono and heterogeneous-bind implementations under the unprimed names, remo

Fix `Array I8` in the signed byte-conversion models (#1355)

* Fix `Array I8` in the signed byte-conversion models

Rust's i8..i128 to_le_bytes/to_be_bytes/from_le_bytes/from_be_bytes all use
[u8; N] - the bytes are unsigned regardless of the integer's signedness. The
Lean models for signed scalars declared Array I8 N, while extraction correctly
passes Array U8 N, so any crate that feeds a u8 buffer through a signed
conversion produced Lean that

Add regression test for Region ID fix (#1296)

* add test

* update test

Co-authored-by: Oliver Butterley <51876429+oliver-butterley@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Oliver Butterley <oliver.butterley@gmail.com>

Fix Usize inequality lifting in bvify (#1208)

This PR fixes a regression introduced by #1000 by adding the missing Usize.lt_bv and Usize.le_bv theorems for bvify.

Example proof hitting the regression: https://github.com/AeneasVerif/jxl-proofs/blob/f365cc22b372396949021d36c321f9033d0f326b/lean/JxlProofs/Proofs.lean#L86

Gemini was used to debug and fix this issue, after which I have reviewed and tested the PR.

* Update the scalar cast simp lemmas

* Set ematch:=3 and instances:=100 by default for step

* Mark ite_self as @[step_simps]

cases.title: fix: fix default impl of Ord::max,min
cases.invariant: Ord ties select distinguishable equal operands correctly; numerical min/max equalities alone miss identity choice.
cases.material_evidence_summary: Cmp.lean switches comparison to lt y x; later #1360 adds ties tests.

cases.title: Rocq Axiom `mk_array` is unsound
cases.invariant: Rocq mk_array assumes length without checking input; constructing array False 1 from [] yields False.
cases.material_evidence_summary: Reported proof, maintainer agrees. Specific to Rocq axioms; no Lean inconsistency inference.

cases.title: Wrong translation with slice update in tuple
cases.invariant: Tuple/slice field updates must retain both updated values rather than replacing one by Unit.
cases.material_evidence_summary: Issue reproducer and generated Lean; comment explicitly attributes fix to #1095.

cases.title: Wrong binder for call to `FnMut` closure returning unit.
cases.invariant: Unit elimination must preserve trait return ABI, especially (Unit, updated FnMut state).
cases.material_evidence_summary: Issue+comment identify ignore_output simplification; open status does not establish current repro.

cases.title: Add preliminary support for nested (mutable) borrows
cases.invariant: Ending a nested region abstraction may require ending only sub-abstractions.
cases.material_evidence_summary: PR explicitly preliminary, tests/src/nested-borrows.rs changed.

cases.title: bug: Unsupported nested borrows
cases.invariant: Arrays containing slice references inside loops remain distinct from separate slice locals.
cases.material_evidence_summary: Issue gives failing/passing pair; no independently established fix.

cases.title: Bug: Internal error in `InterpMatchCtxs` when joining loop contexts over non-opaque wrapper holding borrow
cases.invariant: Loop joining over wrapper-with-borrow may fail internally and still emit a partial Lean file.
cases.material_evidence_summary: Self-contained fuzzing report at b86120db/Charon4bd5a29; no local run.

cases.title: Fix minor issues in the symbolic execution and improve performance
cases.invariant: Projection checks must use projected regions, independent projectors and retained ignored metadata; equality must ignore translation-only metadata.
cases.material_evidence_summary: PR details specific predicate and EIgnored changes plus equality performance.

cases.title: Fix several issues in the translation
cases.invariant: Shared borrow projectors may intersect; break contexts require Loop region kind; ADT backward translation must retain values.
cases.material_evidence_summary: Fix bundle with loops/nested-borrows tests; #938 closure explicitly links it.

cases.title: Use a `loop` fixed-point combinator when extracting loops
cases.invariant: Loop fixed-point combinator versus recursion depends on backward-function elimination and structural measure inference.
cases.material_evidence_summary: Mode changes are expected output differences; tests and flags documented.

cases.title: Fix `Array I8` in the signed byte-conversion models
cases.invariant: Signed scalar bytes still have unsigned element type; round-trip tests can hide symmetric model errors.
cases.material_evidence_summary: Patch changes Array I8 to U8; tests/src/builtin.rs adds signed endian cases.

cases.title: Fix the models of the `PartialOrd` and `Ord` default methods - #1274
cases.invariant: Default trait models must accept instance ABI used by extractor, including reference comparison impls.
cases.material_evidence_summary: Patch and order.rs tests cover default methods, partial order None, references, ties.

cases.title: Add regression test for Region ID fix
cases.invariant: A fix and regression test can arrive in separate PRs months apart.
cases.material_evidence_summary: Test-only PR attributes fix to #1158 instantiate_fun_sig; issue765 test paths.

cases.title: Extract type parameters as `Type _` in Lean
cases.invariant: Generic generated code and models need compatible universe levels; generic trait fields remain restricted.
cases.material_evidence_summary: PR body describes target-only universe test, but requested file not found at pin or PR head.

cases.title: Bug: missing drop function
cases.invariant: Filtering a Drop impl can leave LLBC function references dangling.
cases.material_evidence_summary: Issue LLBC reproducer and explicit closer #1191.

cases.title: aeneas: don't hide `Drop` impls
cases.invariant: Aeneas preset must not exclude Drop impls still referenced by extracted glue.
cases.material_evidence_summary: Patch removes two exclude entries; no regression test file in PR.

cases.title: Add a flag that undoes drop elaboration
cases.invariant: Conditional drop resugaring depends on faithful drop flags/place inhabitedness, with restricted detected cases.
cases.material_evidence_summary: New detection/resugar passes, Rust fixtures and generated AST/decoders changed.

cases.title: Fix panic for an `FnDef` with bound vars
cases.invariant: FnDef bound vars may not satisfy no_bound_vars assertion; erasure avoids panic with precision loss.
cases.material_evidence_summary: Patch explicitly says loss of precision; fndef-with-bound-vars.rs regression.

cases.title: `Vec::insert` translated to `.set` instead of `.insertIdx`
cases.invariant: Vec insert must increase length and shift elements; proving a spec for set can validate wrong model.
cases.material_evidence_summary: Patch uses insertIdx plus capacity check but retains strict i<length guard: full Rust boundary equivalence not established.

cases.title: In `InterpLoopsFixedPoint.ml` join the break contexts from two iterations
cases.invariant: Joining break contexts must include abstraction relationships exposed by refreshed identities.
cases.material_evidence_summary: Patch reevaluates break paths; issue1206 regression; excludes last case moved to1349.

cases.title: Use a fresh id when copying a symbolic value with no borrows
cases.invariant: Copying borrow-free symbolic values needs fresh identity so later expansion does not expand frozen original.
cases.material_evidence_summary: Patch+joins.rs; later commit1dc1c98 explicitly follows regressions caused by1379.

cases.title: Fix the elaborator for step
cases.invariant: Malformed spec/config arguments must throw, not recover into synthetic sorry terms; parser registration unambiguous.
cases.material_evidence_summary: Target-only ParserErrors.lean checks malformed syntax, errors, fallback branch.

cases.title: Implement `PrePasses.fix_closure_signature_regions`
cases.invariant: Closure signatures with exactly one bound region can repair erased region arguments; not general lifetime reconstruction.
cases.material_evidence_summary: PrePasses patch and issue1207 regression; mitigates Charon1040.

cases.title: Fix escaping bound var for HRTB
cases.invariant: Translate higher-ranked region binder before erasing it, rather than skipping binder unsafely.
cases.material_evidence_summary: translate_predicates patch; broad golden churn does not alone prove all HRTB cases.

cases.title: Fix `vec!` reconstruction with repeated elements
cases.invariant: vec literal reconstruction must recognize repeat rvalue as well as array aggregates.
cases.material_evidence_summary: Patch retains Rvalue and type; repeated_value Rust+out fixtures.

cases.title: Fix the output type of known-length array subslices
cases.invariant: Statically sized array subslices require concretization from slice reference to array reference.
cases.material_evidence_summary: Patch adds Concretize cast; issue320 golden fixture changes.

comments.summary: That is correct. But at this stage I'm pondering whether I should not simply deprecate the F*, Rocq and HOL4 backends: they are not maintained.

normative_api_documents.requirement_summary: Equal comparison selects second argument for max, first for min.
